extracted.intended_audience: researchers, patent historians, librarians, and practitioners looking up historical US patents and trade-marks (patentee names, patent numbers, dates, and Gazette references)
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index of patents and trade-marks issued by the United States Patent Office in 1878, listing invention names, patentees, patent numbers, issue dates, monthly volume and Official Gazette page references. Useful for locating specific 1878 patent/trademark records or citation metadata.
